nonclaims: No production integration or controller adoption has occurred.
No queue task was launched and no scientific result was computed.
This stage was not tested against a live task admission; root must independently review and decide whether to integrate.

output_size_basis.evidence: The existing bounded inventory cited in the task context measured 302 successful E4/E5 RF/ExtraTrees evaluation outputs; largest test_outcomes.npz was 1,677,742 bytes and largest checked alias JSON was 2,805 bytes.
output_size_basis.limitations: The cited output-size observation is a historical bounded inventory, not an exhaustive guarantee for every future artifact or filesystem condition. The 20 GiB hard floor is retained.
output_size_basis.reserve_comparison: 2 GiB per active/new drain task remains the unchanged policy reserve; it is over 214 times the 10,000,000-byte raw-array payload at the stated 500,000-row scope, before compression and small container metadata.

scope_bound.calculation: IDs int64 (8) + predicted class int8 (1) + packed set byte (1) + covered bool (1) + set_size int64 (8) + fallback bool (1).
scope_bound.evidence: Root read-only source review of current writer schema; no output arrays were read or written for this bound.

output_size_basis.writer_behavior: _eval_phase predicts in chunks, writes test_outcomes.npz.tmp then atomically replaces test_outcomes.npz; evaluation results/metrics are small JSON. It does not serialize a model. The per-active/new-task 2 GiB allowance is over 1,200 times the observed largest NPZ, but remains an operational reserve, not a mathematical output bound.

policy.active_task_rule: All already-running tasks must themselves qualify as the narrow evaluation/clean-alias drain tasks; any active fit, generation, other task type, failed dependency, or archive overlap blocks drain admission.
policy.archive_hold_policy: Requires archive_fit_overlap_context mode inactive and no operator ADMISSION_HOLD. STORAGE_HOLD remains a status marker; it does not permit archive overlap.
policy.attempt_metadata: Admitted attempt resource_profile receives storage_drain_policy evidence with dependency, artifact, disk gate and policy identities.
policy.attempt_policy: Any ready task with prior attempts is ineligible. No fitting, generation, tuning trial, retry, refit, or model serialization is admitted through this path.

disk_gate.required_formula: 20 GiB + 2 GiB * (number of active drain tasks + one proposed task)

eligible: Ready E4 or E5 eval tasks whose method is random_forest or extra_trees, route is one of the frozen E4/E5 routes, no prior task attempts, and whose single matching fit dependency is validated_terminal/successful.

Fit task result, fit_result.json, validation.json, and physical artifacts/<fit_key>/pipeline.joblib must agree on the selected pipeline SHA; file and directory paths must be canonical, confined, regular, and non-symlink.
Ready E5 direct clean alias tasks only when their exact same-repetition/method E4 direct control source is successful and validated, with evaluation.json matching the source validation manifest.
policy.hash_io: The first selected physical model is SHA-256 streamed in 4 MiB chunks with before/open/after stat identity checks and O_NOFOLLOW. A bounded 256-entry cache is keyed by device/inode/size/mtime/ctime; no joblib load or model deserialization occurs.
policy.ordinary_storage_forecast: UNCHANGED; storage_allow() AST source is byte-identical to current live controller
policy.resource_policy: Existing controller admission_candidate remains authoritative for current RAM/CPU reservation, task timeout, native-thread controls, checkpointing, and process supervision; no scientific settings or limits are changed.
policy.scheduling_io: Candidates are visited in the controller existing ready order and the first eligible one is selected; it does not scan/hash every candidate model on each poll.
policy.trigger: Only in the existing controller branch where normal storage_allow() is false. The standard fit/generation future-space gate is never bypassed.

scope: Storage-forecast fallback for already-fitted E4/E5 random_forest or extra_trees evaluation tasks, plus E5 clean evaluation-result aliases only.
